element: Explain dataset fit; audit, clean, split and run one baseline
Count non-English samples by domain/class; review flags with a second detector and inspect disagreements
Translate the fixed 3,500 English test items into Spanish and French; inspect 20 pairs per language
Score Spanish and French with the frozen logistic-regression model
Train XLM-RoBERTa-base on the same training IDs; select its threshold on validation only
Compare both classifiers on all three languages, per domain and aggregate mean/weighted performance; all 24 XLM-R cells
Interpret language effects, check limitations and rerun the final package; add independent bilingual review
